sights.address: 7440 W Old Sauk Rd, Middleton (Town), WI 53562
sights.w: 105 acres atop three glacial moraines with prairie restorations, a Native American garden and 8 miles of trails — famous for Sunflower Days, half a million blooms that once drew 92,000 visitors in nine days.
Drumlin-top park with Depression-era CWA/WPA rustic stone shelter, fireplaces, stairs and the Sunset Point lookout, plus 1850s sandstone quarries; on the National Register since 2018.

sights.n: The Red Gym (UW Armory and Gymnasium)
sights.w: 1894 castle-like armory-gymnasium on Lake Mendota's shore — a National Historic Landmark (1993) that now houses UW's visitor and welcome center.
